parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, one per logical submit (a retry reuses it). The key is global: a repeat with the same method, path and body replays the first response (header Idempotency-Replayed: true); the same key with any other request is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
